memory:
User plans flexible round-trip Economy travel from Washington, DC to San Francisco (IAD preferred for nonstop) in a few weeks, budget ~$400 but willing to splurge; nonstop IAD-SFO cited at $410–$430. They have United Premier Gold status and want fare-sale/error-fare alerts; no confirmed live fares. 

REMINDERS (from a consistency check against the session):
- The user has a United MileagePlus account; S omits this.
- The user currently uses a spreadsheet to track travel expenses; S omits this.
- The user is considering Expensify, starting with its free plan; S omits this.
- The user plans to wait and see whether the nonstop fare drops below its current price; S omits this plan.
- S says the preferred departure airport is IAD, but R states only Washington, D.C.—no specific airport was stated.
- S cites a nonstop IAD–SFO price of $410–$430, but R gives no fare amount; R only says the user will wait to see whether the current nonstop fare drops.
- S says the user wants fare-sale and error-fare alerts, but R states only an interest in waiting for a sale or fare drop—no error-fare alerts were specified.
